findings.problem: .mask sets a literal letter-spacing: 0.04em instead of a tracking token. Every other letter-spacing in the stylesheets uses --tracking-* (a tracking token for the mono face already exists and is used elsewhere, e.g. base.css/requisitions.css). This is the only hardcoded spacing/letter-spacing value in the whole M3 web diff.
findings.fix: Replace `letter-spacing: 0.04em` with the existing mono tracking token (var(--tracking-label) or a dedicated mono tracking token already defined in tokens.css), so the mask face stays token-driven.
